question: On the fixed 36-case epoch-491 K=10000 benchmark, does the coherent canonical source-geometry and query-frame intervention keep every one of four cohort-mean relative-L2 endpoints at or below 1.02 times the exact frozen legacy baseline?

hypothesis.prediction: Two target-blind, process-isolated canonical replicas will be raw-byte identical, will pass every frozen pairing and canonical-frame control, and will place all four cohort means at or below their inclusive preregistered ceilings.
hypothesis.falsifier: Both canonical replicas, the fresh unchanged-legacy sentinel, the sealed Stage-B license, and all pairing/frame controls are valid, but at least one reproducible canonical cohort mean is above its frozen inclusive ceiling.
not_a_falsifier: a missing producer, lane, sidecar, sealed Stage-B artifact, result record, tree manifest, or reducer artifact
a source, config, checkpoint, manifest, correction-record, Stage-B-license, or staged-tree hash mismatch
a canonical A-versus-B raw-byte mismatch, including signed zero
a fresh legacy sentinel mismatch against either sealed Stage-B lane
a selected-cell, raw-geometry, pipeline-input, coherent-frame, target-chain, process-separation, or training-to-physical control failure
a malformed, aliased, non-transactional, non-finite, or schema-invalid artifact

scientific_scope.claim_if_passed: fixed 36-case epoch-491 K=10000 ID-reference benchmark canonical noninferiority on all four preregistered cohort-mean endpoints
scientific_scope.intervention: coherent source geometry plus coordinate-frame intervention: source points, connectivity, centroids, areas, normals, center, reference length, and decode queries change together according to the frozen canonical construction
held_fixed: 36 ordered cases and historical K=10000 selected-cell intervals
raw referenced boundary geometry and global inputs before the intervention
epoch-491 model, training-state, and normalization artifacts
selected Stage-B truths, per-case metric definitions, cohort reduction, and four prospective ceilings
does_not_support: an architecture-level or H-QC mechanism claim
absolute native areas, force integration, or force accuracy
scientific_scope.casewise_metric_role: reported descriptively only; no casewise metric cutoff is deciding
scientific_scope.historical_pointwise_mean_wss_role: confirmed wrong historical reduction; descriptive only and never deciding

passed_paths: producer JSON and NPZ output paths
not_passed_or_opened: sealed Stage-B producer lanes, adjudication, seal, or result record
four baseline means or four ceilings
canonical_producer_isolation.isolation_semantics: interface and reviewed-source target blindness, not an operating-system filesystem sandbox

lane_contract.processes: three concurrent, separate one-rank torchrun process trees under env -i and setsid
lane_contract.canonical_replica_requirement: raw-byte equality of all 792 persisted arrays, including signed zero

fresh_legacy_sentinel.label: A
fresh_legacy_sentinel.required_control: raw-byte equality of all 720 arrays against both sealed Stage-B lanes
fresh_legacy_sentinel.failure_semantics: missing sentinel is incomplete; any present exact-replay miss is instrument invalidity only
fresh_legacy_sentinel.ceiling_semantics: the sentinel never changes, recomputes, or substitutes the sealed baseline means or ceilings
fresh_legacy_sentinel.scientific_role: execution-environment sentinel only; not a fresh deciding baseline

lane_contract.output_sets: distinct immutable JSON, NPZ, canonical sidecars, and logs for all three lanes
lane_contract.checkpoint_selection: explicit load_checkpoint(..., epoch=491) in both frozen producers
lane_contract.canonical_process_provenance: each canonical JSON must persist distinct PID, CUDA token, one-rank environment, common Slurm job, hostname, and checkpoint hashes
lane_contract.sentinel_process_limitation: the unchanged legacy producer does not persist PID/GPU/job; the wrapper attests its separate process tree, GPU token, log, and heartbeat

pairing_and_frame_controls.precanonical_pairing: selected cells, compacted connectivity, raw/pipeline geometry, globals, and pipeline center are paired to the exact sealed Stage-B lane
pairing_and_frame_controls.canonical_construction: raw selected coordinates are promoted to float64; the physical area-weighted center is removed; points, centroids, and areas are coherently scaled by L_ref times model reference length; geometry is cast to float32 once
pairing_and_frame_controls.canonical_query_frame: decode once at the exact canonical centroids

deciding_endpoints.reduction: unweighted arithmetic mean across the fixed 36 ordered per-case metrics, computed in float64
deciding_endpoints.inclusive_comparison: canonical cohort mean <= frozen prospective absolute ceiling
deciding_endpoints.area_weight_semantics: normalized relative triangle weights independently derived in float64 from sealed Stage-B raw boundary points and connectivity

stage_b_v2_license.scope: licenses only this separately frozen fixed-cohort paired comparison and its four prospective ceilings

job_306114_exclusion.reason: the old validity producer omitted epoch=491 and did not attest the model checkpoint it opened
job_306114_exclusion.retained_role: target-free canonical API runtime validity only
job_306114_exclusion.repair: fresh target-blind canonical A/B inference with explicit epoch=491 in this experiment

truth_table.condition: the full instrument is valid, canonical replicas are exact, the fresh sentinel exactly reproduces both sealed legacy lanes, all pairing/frame controls pass, and all four canonical cohort means are at or below their inclusive ceilings
the same full validity gates pass, but one or more reproducible canonical cohort means are above their inclusive ceilings
a present artifact, provenance binding, producer-replica check, sentinel replay, process-separation check, pairing/frame control, Stage-B license, or baseline recomputation is invalid
at least one required artifact is absent and no present artifact establishes invalidity

execution_exit_semantics.CANONICAL_NONINFERIORITY_PASS: reducer exit 0 and successful completed wrapper job
execution_exit_semantics.VALID_CANONICAL_NONINFERIORITY_REFUTATIO: reducer exit 0 and successful completed wrapper job; scientific refutation must not be converted into infrastructure failure
execution_exit_semantics.INVALID_CANONICAL_COMPARISON: reducer exit 2 followed by blocked nonzero wrapper exit
execution_exit_semantics.INCOMPLETE_CANONICAL_COMPARISON: reducer exit 3 followed by blocked nonzero wrapper exit

decision_order.CANONICAL_NONINFERIORITY_PASS: retain the fixed-cohort result; next test matched canonical-path training rather than claiming population generalization or superiority
decision_order.VALID_CANONICAL_NONINFERIORITY_REFUTATIO: retain the refutation; use paired case diagnostics to formulate one mechanistic, preregistered follow-up rather than sweeping architectures
decision_order.INVALID_CANONICAL_COMPARISON: repair and rerun this instrument; no accuracy evidence
decision_order.INCOMPLETE_CANONICAL_COMPARISON: complete or rerun this instrument; no accuracy evidence

hash_cycle_policy: the wrapper binds this preregistration, but this preregistration intentionally does not bind the wrapper
